sections.featuresTitle: Ka aika daidai. Ka gina aminci. Ka yi bacci lafiya.
sections.featuresSub: Kayan aiki shida da ke mayar da rudanin haraji na Najeriya zuwa hanyar bayani — da rikodin da masu ba da rango ke amincewa da shi.
sections.f1Body: Haraji na dukiya, VAT, WHT ana lissafa su a cikin daƙiƙa — duka a ₦, da tushen da za ka iya amincewa.
sections.f2Body: Amsoshin da aka yi la'akari da su kan dokar haraji ta Najeriya — VAT, PAYE, WHT, TIN — ba tare da ƙalubale.
sections.f3Title: Gina aminci ga masu ba da rango
sections.f3Body: Tarihin aikinka na aika haraji ya zama makin da bankuna ke fahimta — rikodi mai kyau, rango mai sauƙi.
sections.f4Body: Bi diddigin lokaci, shirya takardun maye gurbin, kuma nemi Takardar tabbatar da haraji kafin lokaci.
sections.f5Title: Takardun da ke yi aiki saboda ka
sections.f5Body: Ka zub da rasit da fatun — muna fitar da lambobi kuma mu kan da su shirye don aika.
sections.f6Title: Ƙwarin haraji da aka tabbatar a kusa da kai
sections.f6Body: Nemo ƙwarin gajeren CAC lokacin da aiki ya yi tsanani — taswira, kila, tuntuɓe kai tsaye.
sections.howTitle: Matakai uku zuwa rikodin da masu rango ke amincewa
sections.how1Body: Bayyana yanayin ka cikin harshen gida ko ka zubar da takarda.
sections.how2Title: Samu amsoshin da aka yi la'akari
sections.how2Body: Lambobi da suka shirya don aika da amsoshin da ya dogara ne kan dokar haraji ta Najeriya.
sections.how3Body: Mayar da rikodin biyayya zuwa bayanan aminci da masu ba da rango ke fahimta.
sections.stat1Label: nau'in haraji na Najeriya da mukuf cinsa
sections.pubsTitle: An fitar da mu cikin jaridu
sections.pubsSub: Abin da marubuta da abokan hulɗa ke cewa game da dandalin haraji da rango da aka gina domin Najeriya.
sections.stake1Title: Faɗa mini abin da na bin. Taimaka min aika. Ka sa masu ranto su amince da ni.
sections.stake1Body: Dashboard ɗaya don lafiyar harajinka, aikawa da aminci — cikin harshen da kake tunani.
sections.stake2Title: Abokan ciniki da aka tabbatar. Lissafi mai yawa. Takarda kaɗan.
sections.stake2Body: Shiga kasuwa, tabbatar da shaidar kai da alamu, kuma gudanar da lissafin abokan ciniki a badan.
sections.stake3Title: Ginshiƙan haraji na Najeriya masu dogaro da za ka gina su
sections.stake3Body: API masu tsabta don haraji, rango da takardu tare da tsaron da ƙungiyar biyayya taka ke tsammani.
sections.marketTitle: Nemo ƙwarin haraji da aka tabbatar a kusa da kai
sections.marketSub: Ƙwarin gajeren da aka duba tare da kima da tuntuɓe kai tsaye.
sections.pricingTitle: Fara kyauta. Ka biya lokacin aikawa.
sections.pricingSub: Ma'aunin asali da amsoshin suna nan kyauta har abada. Aikawa da rahotanni ana biya yayin amfani.
sections.newsTitle: Ranakun haraji, a bayyane da kuma da wuri
sections.newsSub: Imel wata-maza ta wata: abin da ya canza a dokar haraji ta Najeriya, da abin da yake nufi ga kuɗin ka.
sections.newsSuccess: Ka yi rijista — wasiki na gaba zai shiga akwatin saƙoninka.
sections.newsError: Shigar da imel mai inganci don yin rijista.
sections.stake4Title: Kowane aika haraji a lokacin da ya dace yana ɗaga makin ka.
sections.stake4Body: Ga yadda tarihin haraji, ɗorewar takarda da salon biyan kuɗi ke haɗuwa zuwa alamar rango da masu ba da rango a Najeriya ke ganewa.
sections.stake5Title: Rasit sun shiga. Lambobi sun fito. Sun shirya don aikawa.
sections.stake5Body: Ka zub da hotunan rasit da fatun — muna fitar da adadi, rarraba kashe kuɗi, kuma kiyaye komai a shirye don maye gurbin ka na gaba.
sections.stake6Title: Biyan kuɗin ma'aikata, VAT da aikawa — ba tare da rudanin lissafi ba.
sections.stake6Body: Gudanar da jadawalin PAYE, bi diddigin VAT a cikin kwata, kuma kiyaye takardun biyayya a shirye don dubawa ga tawagar ka gaba ɗaya.

waitlist.title: Shiga jerin
waitlist.desc: Samun early access yana buɗuwa a kashi. Ka sa imel ɗinka kuma za mu sanar da ka nan take da Creditax ta fito.
waitlist.success: Kana cikin jerin. Za mu aika maka imel lokacin da Creditax ta fito.
waitlist.successDuplicate: Wannan imel ya riga ya kasance cikin jerin — babu abin da za a yi.
waitlist.successDesc: Babu spam. Imel ɗaya na fitowa, sa'an nan abin da ka zaɓa kawai.
waitlist.error: Wani abu ya lalace a gefenmu. Muna gyara — sake gwadawa da ƙanƙanin lokaci.
waitlist.note: Imel ɗaya a lokacin fitowa. Soke kowane lokaci.
